aosSalesConfig.interpretationQ12Q15: PS-Q12 governs approved physical mounting (only manufacturer-supported frame/mount combinations are buildable). PS-Q15 allows an explicitly marked conceptual layout where mounting is unresolved, after James acknowledges technical review. A conceptual placement is not a verified installation, quote-ready detail or code-approved guard.
designerInvariants: Adding, moving, editing or removing privacy modules never changes deck shape, edge geometry, stairs, guard selections outside the intentionally occupied section, patio/walkway or other saved choices.
Store individual privacy-panel IDs, system IDs, pattern/finish, locations and overrides; save/reopen and undo/redo preserve them.
Handle occupied perimeter edges explicitly; preview visibility is separate from authorization to remove a required guard.
Never conflate Privacy Rail with Freestyle screens, RDI or Westbury guard railings, or AOS wood railing.
Keep manufacturer sizes and restrictions; never invent dimensions, colors/patterns, connectors, span limits, wind capacities or mounting approval.
Customers see design concepts, product identity and selections without product quantities (D-08), and no implied installation or engineering certification.
openQuestions: Standard 6 ft Privacy Rail modules vs wind-load post spacing (3 ft / 30 in): in wind-exposed projects a full-height wall needs extra posts. Which projects count as advanced wind-load is a technical-review item.
researchItems: Freestyle outer frame dimensions, deck attachment and structural requirements; manufacturer-approved mounting kits for wood framing.
Privacy Rail perimeter anchorage, post spacing by height, blocking and wind exposure per project; guard approval for any assembly (not assumed).
Manufacturer asset permissions, pattern/color imagery, AOS supplier stock.
Saved-project, step-ID, undo/redo and UI-census migration for the Privacy & Screens step at the D-07 position (developer, at integration).

resolvedQuestions.question: Does the perimeter-only rule (PS-Q06, Privacy Rail) also apply to Freestyle screen placement? The owner form did not decide this; not assumed.
Default Freestyle panel color for Boardwalk 2x4 (Black, White or Umber)? Not decided by the form; not inferred.
Insertion point of the Privacy & Screens step in the expanded workflow, and how saved projects migrate.
